description:
Wyoming — a place where nature still owns the horizon. 
Vast plains, lonely deserts, mountains carved by ice and wind. Small towns that rose with the railroad. 
And beneath it all, a supervolcano sleeps under Yellowstone. 
A reminder of how fragile, and extraordinary, our world really is.
